blocks.text: The most common biological hazards are allergens, infectious diseases that are transferred from animals to humans, and viral diseases (Figure 16.3).

blocks.alt: A red panel headed Biological Hazards with a rod-shaped microbe in the middle and four circled labels: Microbes, Animals, Plants, Genetically modified agents.
blocks.caption: Figure 16.3: Some biological hazards (original drawing after the textbook's Figure 16.3).
